REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - SEPTEMBER 8, 2016 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
SEPTEMBER 8, 2016, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Lohman, New Life Community Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Campers-in-Leadership members Joshua Mahar,
  Joanne Huynh, and Brian Kim.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Carol Chen
  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor/Chair George Ray

  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki was noted absent for the record.

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  None.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Gail Grossman expressed concerns about potential budget reductions and
  expenditures and lack of public meetings.

  Marty Grossman expressed concerns regarding Councilmember salaries and
  pensions and potential budget reductions and expenditures.

  Marlene Rofe spoke regarding “right-sizing” the City organization.

  Anantha Ramachandran expressed concerns regarding the Astor Museum contract
  and the implementation of OpenGov.
 City of Cerritos  September 8, 2016

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated September 8,
  2016 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register
  of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated September 8, 2016 in the total amount of
  $5,559,697.57 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending July 31, 2016
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending July 31, 2016. The motion carried (4 – 0)
  as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of August
  25, 2016 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of August 25, 2016
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  September 8, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 5

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING SECTION 22.22.700(15) AND SECTION
  22.74.300 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE ADDING REGULATIONS AND
  REQUIREMENTS FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF ENCLOSED GARAGES CONTAINING
  THREE PARKING SPACES FOR SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCES, HEREIN REFERENCED
  AS DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2016-6 (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager. A PowerPoint
  Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.

  Anantha Ramachandran requested that the City require garage inspections prior to the
  issuance of on-street parking passes.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments and the public hearing.

  CONSENSUS (Ray): Directed staff to research garage storage and driveway
  widening issues as related to the issuance of street parking passes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Chen, to:

  1. Approve Development Code Amdendment 2016-6, making the findings set forth in
  Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. 2016-22; and
  2. Waive full reading of and introduce Ordinance No. 1007, AN ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING SECTION 22.22.700(15) AND SECTION
  22.74.300 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE ADDING REGULATIONS
  AND REQUIREMENTS FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF ENCLOSED GARAGES
  CONTAINING THREE PARKING SPACES FOR SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCES,
  HEREIN REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2016-6
  (COUNCIL).*

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  September 8, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 5

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of designation of voting delegate and alternate for
  the League of California Cities Annual Business Meeting on Friday, October 7,
  2016 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to select Councilmember
  Carol Chen as the voting delegate for the League of California Cities Annual Business
  Meeting on Friday, October 7, 2016 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for Implementation of Bikeway
  Master Plan, Project No. 13088, Bid No. 1267-17 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works. A
  PowerPoint Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Pulido, to:

  1. Award a contract in the amount of $89,900.00 for Implementation of Bikeway
  Master Plan, Project No. 13088, Bid No. 1267-17, to Superior Pavement Markings
  and reject the other bids; and
  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any project-related change
  orders (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  September 8, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 5

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  Award of Bid No. 1261-17, Employee Uniform Purchase (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Ryan Carey, Budget Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to award Bid No. 1261-
  17 to Image Apparel for Business for a three (3) year term with an option to renew for
  two additional one (1) year periods from the date of acceptance by the City (COUNCIL).
  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki
  ABSTAIN:  None

10A.  Report on pending legislation

  None.

  The meeting was adjourned at 8:29 p.m. in memory of Pilar Miranda Ilao.
